tagline: From equipment telemetry to actionable maintenance intelligence.
brief: GridAware is a multi-tenant B2B SaaS platform for factories and commercial buildings that connects infrastructure registries, live telemetry, threshold/anomaly detection, and traceable maintenance workflows in one calm, dark-first system.
criteria: Success criteria: unmistakable at 16 px and in the 72 px collapsed sidebar rail, works in pure monochrome and dark-first EVARAX color (#F4E952 on #080808), avoids industrial clip-art and blue SaaS clichés, and scales into a full product system.

concepts.name: Node G — Modular Brand Signature
concepts.idea: A bold architectural G fused from a 3×3 infrastructure grid, with its upper-right cell detached as a live EVARAX telemetry node.
rationale: Unites Grid (structured 3×3 facility matrix) and Aware (the single monitored node caught in focus).
High-contrast EVARAX pairing: Pure White (#FFFFFF) + Soft Yellow (#F4E952, 15.85:1) on Near Black (#080808).
Engineered across optical cuts: standard master, pixel-hinted 16 px cut, and 4.3% thinned reversed white cut.
Unbounded Custom logotype: avant-garde wide display grotesque with sculptural ink-traps, bespoke Node-squircle i-tittle, and zero font dependency.

recommendation: Deploy gridaware-horizontal-dark.svg in the 248 px expanded sidebar, gridaware-symbol-small-dark.svg in the 72 px collapsed rail, and the web-icons bundle in apps/web/public.
next_steps: Copy brand/digital/web-icons/* into apps/web/public/ when bootstrapping the Next.js frontend.
Run a formal trademark and reverse-image clearance search in target commercial jurisdictions before commercial launch.
Verify physical Pantone / CMYK drawdowns with print vendors before producing facility signage or uniforms.
